title: Tic-Tac-Toe
hints: Square 1–9 maps to the grid with `row = (n - 1) / 3` and `col = (n - 1) % 3`.
For the random computer player, pick a number 1–9 until you find an empty square.
requirements: Win check for rows, columns and both diagonals; a draw when the board is full
A computer player that picks a random empty square
stretch: An unbeatable computer player with recursive **minimax** (lesson 5.09): try every free square, score the result of the best reply, and pick the square with the best score.
